base_analysis.subject_identity_requirements: Do not reuse reference person identity; target subject should reflect financial advisory professional with approachable authority
existing_composition_constraints: web hero with text overlay expected
elements_forbidden_to_change: communication goal of trust and calm confidence

observations.description: Subject positioned in right third of frame, leaving left two-thirds as open field for copy territory
Controlled backlight creates bright rim/glow halo behind subject's head and shoulders, separating subject from background
Dominant purple/magenta gradient field with darker edges and lighter center behind subject
Subject wears white structured coat with gold buttons, hands in pockets, relaxed confident stance, smiling
Silhouetted NYC skyline visible in background including Empire State Building and Brooklyn Bridge
White coat fabric appears smooth and structured; inner blouse has subtle pattern/texture; watch with metal band on left wrist
Embroidered text on left chest of coat appears to be in non-Latin script
Dotted world map pattern visible in left background behind subject
American flag stars visible in upper right background
Layered depth with subject foreground, cityscape mid-ground, dotted map and gradient background

design_decision_map.target_in_new_composition: Right-third subject placement with left-side copy territory reserved for headline, value proposition, and CTA
design_decision_map.rationale: Preserves subject-copy territorial separation (VKB_COMPACT_2) while recomposing for 16:9 landscape format and financial advisory communication needs. Maintains negative-space confidence and single-focal hierarchy.

design_decision_map.target_in_new_composition: Motivated rim light from behind subject creating edge separation and focal glow, using target-native light source (window, studio kicker, or environmental reflection)
design_decision_map.rationale: Preserves silhouette separation and focal emphasis while changing light temperature and emitter to match financial advisory tone (warmer or neutral rather than purple). Maintains controlled lighting and subject-background separation.

design_decision_map.target_in_new_composition: Dark neutral field (charcoal, navy, or deep burgundy) with single professional subject as focal point
design_decision_map.rationale: Preserves negative-space confidence and single-focal hierarchy while changing color from source purple to target-appropriate professional palette. Maintains value contrast for legibility and focus.

design_decision_map.target_in_new_composition: Business blazer, tailored shirt, or professional attire appropriate to financial advisory context
design_decision_map.rationale: Preserves the authority and trust function of professional dress while adapting from medical category to financial category. Lab coat signals clinical expertise; business attire signals financial expertise. Cross-category translation required.

cross_category_adaptation.literal_object: white lab coat with gold buttons
cross_category_adaptation.visual_function: signal professional authority, expertise, and trustworthiness
cross_category_adaptation.material_language: clean white fabric, structured silhouette, institutional hardware
cross_category_adaptation.emotional_effect: calm confidence, precision, care, institutional trust
cross_category_adaptation.equivalent_adaptation: tailored business blazer or suit in navy, charcoal, or burgundy with structured silhouette
cross_category_adaptation.target_category_coherence: Business attire is the native authority signal for financial advisory; it communicates competence, trust, and professionalism without implying medical practice

design_decision_map.target_in_new_composition: Abstract architectural geometry, financial district structure, or clean spatial environment suggesting institutional presence without literal cityscape copying
design_decision_map.rationale: Preserves the sophisticated urban context while avoiding generic NYC skyline cliché and ensuring target-native environment. Maintains atmospheric depth and institutional scale.

design_decision_map.target_in_new_composition: Subtle textile contrast between outer professional layer and inner garment, or between subject and environment materials
design_decision_map.rationale: Preserves tactile depth and material interest while adapting to business wardrobe codes. Maintains material contrast pairing for visual richness.

design_decision_map.target_in_new_composition: No source text; target copy will be placed in reserved left territory
design_decision_map.rationale: Source text is untrusted, likely brand-specific, and must not leak into target. Copy territory is already reserved by composition. Protects against copy leakage.

design_decision_map.target_in_new_composition: No national symbols unless target brief explicitly requires them
design_decision_map.rationale: Source-specific national symbol has no target relevance and could imply unintended geographic or political positioning. Maintains target neutrality.

design_decision_map.target_in_new_composition: No specific watch; any accessory must be target-appropriate and not copy source
design_decision_map.rationale: Specific watch is source manifestation; timepiece could imply precision but is not necessary and risks copying source. Avoids surface copy.

conflicts.description: Source uses dominant purple/magenta field which conflicts with typical financial advisory trust palettes (navy, charcoal, burgundy, gold). Purple may read as tech or wellness rather than financial trust.
conflicts.translator_position: Change palette to target-native professional tones while preserving dark-field contrast mechanism

conflicts.description: Lab coat and clinical context signal medical expertise, not financial advisory. Direct transfer would create category confusion.
conflicts.translator_position: Replace medical attire with business professional attire while preserving authority function

conflicts.description: Specific NYC skyline (Empire State Building, Brooklyn Bridge) is a recognizable location that may not align with target advisory's actual location or could become generic financial district cliché.
conflicts.translator_position: Replace with abstract architectural geometry or generic professional environment that avoids geographic specificity

non_negotiable_anchors.description: Asymmetric right-third subject placement with left-side copy territory reserved for headline and CTA
non_negotiable_anchors.function: subject-copy territorial separation ensuring legibility and hierarchy
non_negotiable_anchors.reason: Core to reference's negative-space confidence and single-focal hierarchy; directly addresses brief requirement for clear copy territory

non_negotiable_anchors.description: Single focal hierarchy with dark field contrast
non_negotiable_anchors.function: create immediate visual hierarchy and focus on subject
non_negotiable_anchors.reason: Essential for web hero comprehension and trust communication; preserves reference's dominant-subordinate mass system

non_negotiable_anchors.description: Controlled rim/backlight creating edge separation and glow
non_negotiable_anchors.function: separate subject from background and create focal emphasis
non_negotiable_anchors.reason: Key lighting mechanism that adds depth and premium feel; can be adapted to target-native light sources

non_negotiable_anchors.description: Professional authority cue through adapted business attire
non_negotiable_anchors.function: signal expertise, trustworthiness, and institutional credibility
non_negotiable_anchors.reason: Core to target communication goal; requires cross-category adaptation from medical to financial context

flexible_areas.rationale: Source purple is category-specific and must change to target-native professional tones (navy, charcoal, burgundy, warm neutrals) while preserving dark-field contrast
NYC skyline is source-specific; can be replaced with abstract architecture, financial district structure, or clean institutional space
Reference person identity must not transfer; pose can adapt to target subject while maintaining approachable authority
Target-owned typography with clear hierarchy in reserved left territory; no source text or font copying
Specific fabrics and accessories can change to business-appropriate options while maintaining material contrast

risks.description: Material mismatch: Lab coat to business suit translation risks looking like costume if not handled with proper business context and fit
risks.mitigation: Use tailored business blazer with proper fit and financial context; ensure subject appears native to business environment

risks.description: Color vitality: Source purple is highly chromatic; changing to navy/charcoal risks looking washed out if contrast isn't maintained
risks.mitigation: Preserve local chroma through accent lighting or subject warmth against dark field; maintain clean highlights and dark anchors per My Eyes guidance

risks.description: Generic background: Abstract architecture could become generic corporate stock
risks.mitigation: Use specific architectural geometry or spatial structure that reads as institutional rather than decorative; avoid cliché financial district imagery

risks.description: Identity leakage: Source person's likeness must not influence target subject
risks.mitigation: Use entirely different person with different features, pose, and styling; enforce identity protection constraints

risks.description: Over-abstraction: Removing too many reference mechanisms could result in generic corporate hero
risks.mitigation: Retain at least one strong material contrast and the rim light separation mechanism to preserve reference DNA

provenance.notes: Reference reinterpretation for boutique financial advisory. Cross-category translation from medical to financial professional context. My Eyes and VKB advisories integrated.

confidence.rationale: Composition and lighting mechanisms are clearly observed and highly transferable. Cross-category adaptations are well-defined with clear functional equivalents. Minor uncertainty in exact material translation for business context.

what_must_survive: Asymmetric right-third subject placement with left-side copy territory
Single focal hierarchy with dark field contrast
Professional authority cue (adapted to business category)
what_should_survive: Material contrast between subject and environment
Urban sophistication context (adapted to abstract architecture)
what_can_change: Color palette (from purple to target-native professional tones)
Subject attire (from lab coat to business professional)
Background architecture (from NYC skyline to abstract or institutional)
key_conflicts: Source medical/professional context vs target financial advisory context
Source purple palette vs target professional financial palette
Source specific NYC location vs target geographic neutrality
recommended_anchors: Asymmetric composition with reserved copy territory
Dark field with single focal subject
Professional authority through adapted business attire
creative_opportunities: Use warm neutral palette (charcoal, navy, burgundy, cream) with gold or brass accent lighting
Incorporate subtle architectural geometry or financial district abstraction
Add verified financial context artifacts (document, chart, architectural plan) if needed
Use target-native typography with clear hierarchy in left copy territory
warnings: Avoid copying source person identity or likeness
Avoid purple palette and medical symbolism
Avoid generic NYC skyline or financial district clichés
Ensure copy territory remains legible and not crowded by environmental detail
